description: Aménagements cyclables temporaires is a dataset listed in Open Data Seine-Saint-Denis, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Seine-Saint-Denis. Les aménagements cyclables temporaires ont été mis en place suite au premier confinement COVID-19. Ils sont plus rapides à mettre en place que des aménagements cyclables pérennes de part leur nature provisoire. Le fichier contient les champs suivants: le numéro de la route départementale où se situe l'aménagement et la commune où se situe l'aménagement. Coverage: Seine-Saint-Denis. The portal files it under Spatial planning, Town planning, Buildings, Equipment, Housing. The portal shows 58 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-seinesaintdenis-fr-portal.
